Download (or reuse) WorldClim 2.1 monthly temperature normals

Source: R/worldclim.R
worldclim_monthly.Rd

Returns the 12 monthly layers of WorldClim 2.1 (1970-2000 normals) for tmin or tmax, in degrees Celsius. Files are cached in path and are not downloaded again when a valid copy exists. The geodata package is used when installed; otherwise the files are downloaded directly from the same server.

Usage

worldclim_monthly(
  var = c("tmin", "tmax"),
  res = 2.5,
  path,
  country = NULL,
  timeout = 3600,
  progress = getOption("thermify.progress", interactive())
)

Arguments

var

"tmin" or "tmax".

res

Resolution in arc-minutes: 10, 5, 2.5 or 0.5.

path

Cache directory.

country

ISO3 code, required for res = 0.5.

timeout

Download timeout in seconds.

progress

Show the download progress bar. Defaults to the option thermify.progress, or TRUE in interactive sessions.

Value

A 12-layer SpatRaster with layers named m01 to m12.

Details

Global files are used for res 10, 5 and 2.5 arc-minutes. For 30 arc-seconds (res = 0.5) a country ISO3 code is required and the country tile is downloaded (for Chile, "CHL").

References

Fick, S. E., & Hijmans, R. J. (2017). WorldClim 2: new 1-km spatial resolution climate surfaces for global land areas. International Journal of Climatology, 37(12), 4302-4315.
